title: Monotonicity of a threshold count
statement: Let $kf:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ and $s,t,j\in\mathbb{N}$ with $s\leq t$. The number of indices below $j$ at which $kf$ is less than $s$ is at most the number at which $kf$ is less than $t$.
hypotheses_covered: $kf$ is a function from natural numbers to natural numbers.
